Fit a TOP model with a custom second-stage design

Source: R/top_fit.R
top_fit_custom.Rd

Use this interface when predefined baseline, additive, pairwise, or saturated structures do not represent the desired subtype grouping.

Usage

top_fit_custom(
  y,
  covariate,
  design,
  adjustment = NULL,
  missing_value = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  subtype_cutoff = 10
)

Arguments

y

Numeric outcome matrix as described in [top_fit()].

covariate

Numeric vector or one-column matrix whose effect is mapped by `design`.

design

Numeric matrix with one row per retained subtype and one column per custom second-stage effect.

adjustment

Optional additive adjustment covariates.

missing_value

Numeric missing-tumor code for cases, or `NULL`.

start

Optional starting vector.

subtype_cutoff

Subtypes with counts at or below this value are omitted.

Value

A named object of class `top_model`. Summary tables include both the custom covariate and any jointly fitted adjustment covariates.
